sugerir.title: Suggest an aid point
sugerir.lede: Do you know of a shelter, donation collection center, or aid point that isn't on the site? Tell us. Every suggestion is reviewed before it's published — it doesn't appear automatically.

fields.fuente: Source link (post, news article, official page)

placeholders.contexto: Any detail that helps verify it
placeholders.contacto: Email or phone, in case we need to confirm something

kinds.ACOPIO: Donation collection center (where to donate items)

errors.required: City, type, and name are required.
